lessons.keep: Show named workflow stages and an inspectable output such as a pull request.
try: For a Tin outreach demo, retain one contact through drafted email, approval, sent state and a labeled response; keep status labels consistent.
For a repository workflow, show prompt, completed change summary and one readable diff, then explicitly label the user review step.
lessons.avoid: Avoid showing internal sending activity under an Idle heading or switching workflows before a clear result.
lessons.open: Workflow execution, delivered emails, ranking impact, claimed backing and all audio remain unverified.
